page.title: Insights
page.incompleteProfile: Fill in your weight, height, age, and activity level on the settings page first, so the app can automatically calculate your calorie/macro/water targets

bmiGuidance.UNDER: Your weight is below the healthy range — try adding a reasonable amount of calories and protein to reach the normal range
bmiGuidance.NORMAL: Your weight is in the normal range — keep it up
bmiGuidance.OVER: Your weight is slightly above the standard range but not hard to reduce — keep following your goal
bmiGuidance.OBESE1: Your weight is noticeably above the standard range, but it's manageable — don't worry, keep following your goal
bmiGuidance.OBESE2: Your weight is in the obese range — consider consulting a doctor or specialist for an appropriate plan

page.bmiAsianCriteriaNote: Uses Asian BMI criteria (WHO Asia-Pacific region / Thai Ministry of Public Health), which is stricter than the general international standard — some body composition devices (e.g. InBody) use the broader international criteria (normal up to 25), so the same BMI number can get a different label. That's not a calculation error.

macroPreferencesForm.intro: Only protein and fat can be adjusted — carbs are always calculated from the remaining calories, so it always adds up to 100% no matter where you set them, and the full adjustable range stays within a safe zone.

macroPreferencesForm.tip1: The defaults already suit most people — you don't have to adjust anything
macroPreferencesForm.tip2: Want more energy from carbs (e.g. focused on running/cardio)? → lower fat, carbs increase automatically
macroPreferencesForm.tip3: Want to focus on building/maintaining muscle? → raise protein
